title: Lifting a functor equivalence through a fully faithful Yoneda image
statement: Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$ and use the quasicategories, coherent functors, full subcategories, equivalences and functor categories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal X,\mathcal Y,\mathcal C$ be infinity categories fitting in $\mathcal U'$ and let $J:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be fully faithful. Let $\mathcal Y_0$ be the full subcategory on objects equivalent to some $Jx$, and $J_0:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y_0$ its corestriction, as in [lem-coef-infinity-full-essential-image]. For coherent functors $F,G:\mathcal C\to\mathcal X$ and any coherent natural equivalence $\alpha:JF\simeq JG$ in $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C,\mathcal Y)$, there is a coherent natural equivalence $\beta:F\simeq G$ whose image under postcomposition by $J$ is homotopic to $\alpha$. All functor categories here may be formed in an auxiliary universe containing $\mathcal U'$.
